name: commerce
description: Vendor shopping verbs (shop/browse/buy/sell/checkout) and balance display. `buy` with no vendor NPC in the room hands off to the `storefront.buy_by_name` action (player-owned shop displays) before refusing. Vendor services (stock, pricing, trust, restock) stay engine. Also owns shop HOURS as a room rule: a `commerce:shop-hours` move gate locks an interior shop while every vendor who works it is off the clock, and a 30s closing sweep puts anyone still inside back out on the street. And SELF-SERVICE: goods pulled from a `vendor_stock` display cooler carry an unpaid mark (engine stamps it), `checkout` settles it at a `checkout`-flagged counter, and carrying it out of the shop building emits `shoplifting.caught` for surveillance to charge.

shop.note: KNOWN GAP: vendor NPC verb; examine shows only talk/attack for NPCs. Discoverable via the click-a-vendor shop panel / dialogue, not examine.

browse.note: KNOWN GAP: alias of shop; same NPC gap.

buy.note: KNOWN GAP: targets on-scene vendor via resolveVendor; NPC-gated, discoverable via shop panel.

sell.note: KNOWN GAP: targets on-scene vendor via resolveVendor; NPC-gated, discoverable via shop panel.

checkout.note: Gated on a furniture counter flagged `checkout: <npcId>` in the room; taught by the unpaid-goods line printed when you pull from a vendor_stock cooler.
